queries.name: hot only, last hour, count
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: merge, service kafka, last hour
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all WHERE ServiceName = 'kafka' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: merge, service kafka and one day
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all WHERE ServiceName = 'kafka' AND day = today() SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: merge, time only, the shape HyperDX sends
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: merge, text search, no other filter
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'snapshot') > 0 SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: merge, one pattern text, no time filter
queries.sql: SELECT count() FROM default.otel_logs_all WHERE LogAttributes['message_pattern'] != '' AND LogAttributes['message_pattern'] = (SELECT message_pattern FROM default.counts_by_type WHERE source = 'cold' AND message_pattern != '' ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: merge, one pattern hash, hot and cold side by side
queries.sql: SELECT _table, count() FROM default.otel_logs_all WHERE LogAttributes['tenx_hash'] != '' GROUP BY _table SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0

queries.name: counts table, count all by service, last hour
queries.sql: SELECT ServiceName, sum(cnt) FROM default.counts_by_type WHERE Minute >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY sum(cnt) DESC SETTINGS use_cache_for_count_from_files = 0
